stepBody: See image. Only type what is in the blank, do not include what is provided. Do not use spaces unless absolutely necessary. Please use double quotes (" "), instead of single quotes (' '). If you are utilizing the table, please use the numbers in order.##figure23.gif##

figureAlts.figure23.gif: (d) Return an array that contains ratios of legendary to non-legendary pokemons for each generation. You may assume that the Legendary column is a column of booleans. The code includes several blanks to fill in: helper is assigned pokemon followed by Blank 1 with two arguments, Blank 2 and Blank 3. Ratios is assigned helper followed by Blank 4 with one argument, Blank 5, divided by helper followed by Blank 6 with one argument, Blank 7.
